name: neve-contract-risk-rules
description: Synthetic agreements with the contract-risk findings a careful reader expects. Labels are rule-finding keys without clause IDs, e.g. missing_clause:notice. All text is invented for testing.

clauses.text: The tenant pays rent of Tk 25,000 by the 5th day of each month by bank transfer.
A deposit of Tk 50,000 is refunded within 30 days of the tenant leaving.
The tenancy runs for 12 months from 1 January 2026.
Either party gives 2 months written notice to end the tenancy.
The landlord repairs structural damage; the tenant handles minor repairs.
The tenant pays electricity, gas and water bills.
